item.title: Indianapolis education bill faces criticism over mayor-appointed oversight panel
item.description: Parents and teachers in Indianapolis have expressed their opposition to the mayor appointing all members of a proposed oversight panel for Indianapolis Public Schools, citing concerns of centralized control and lack of accountability.

item.title: Funeral services set for Eskenazi Hospital benefactor Lois Eskenazi
item.description: Lois Eskenazi, a benefactor of Eskenazi Hospital in Indianapolis, died at the age of 92 and is survived by her husband, three children, and seven grandchildren.

item.title: Parent of autistic student intends to sue IPS over teacher misconduct allegations
item.description: Attorneys representing a 5-year-old autistic student and his parent have filed a tort claim against Indianapolis Public Schools for alleged physical and verbal abuse by a teacher, as well as failure to notify the parent of the abuse.

item.title: Pascal Siakam’s game-winning shot lifts Pacers over Celtics
item.description: Pascal Siakam scored 21 points, including a 7-foot bank shot with 6.1 seconds remaining, to lead the Indiana Pacers to a 98-96 win over the Boston Celtics.

item.title: Sheriff limits ICE detainee hold time to 48 hours amid overcrowding crisis
item.description: The Marion County Sheriff has implemented a new policy limiting the duration of ICE detainees held in custody to 48 hours in response to overcrowding and budgetary constraints.

item.title: Teenagers can explore health careers at UIndy summer camp
item.description: The University of Indianapolis is offering a summer camp for teenagers interested in exploring health careers, providing hands-on experiences and opportunities to learn from health care professionals.

item.title: Delta adds nonstop flights for IU football fans heading to Miami
item.description: Delta is offering special nonstop flights from Indianapolis to Miami for the College Football National Championship game between the undefeated Indiana Hoosiers and No. 10 Miami Hurricanes.

item.title: Parents receive decades-long sentences for neglect of baby who died
item.description: A mother and father from Anderson, Indiana, were sentenced to decades in prison for the neglect and death of their 17-month-old child.

item.title: IMPD: Man arrested after beating roommate who ate catfish leftovers
item.description: Davante Payne was arrested and charged with multiple crimes after allegedly attacking a person with a baseball bat, firing a gun at them, and stealing their phone and wallet over a dispute about a $10 meal.

item.title: 2 found dead with gunshot wounds in Linton
item.description: A male and female were found dead with gunshot wounds in a home in Linton, Indiana, and Indiana State Police detectives are investigating the case.
